data.name: Big Day
data.detailed_description:
Developed by Sonic Shield and published by Zodiac Interactive, Big Day is an intense pixel-art shooter ARPG. Set in the smashed-up aftermath of a crippling zombie outbreak, you’ll pit your wits (and trigger fingers) against hordes of the marauding undead.
Combining a top-down viewpoint with lightning fast combat, you’ll need to build and strengthen your arsenal of boomsticks to have any hope of rescuing your lost daughter, as well as finding out exactly what started this mess in the first place.

  • Story:

    Zombies! Just like in the movies! Society is on its knees, and simple farmer Pancho must travel across what remains of the planet order to rescue his daughter Liz. Along the way he’ll find himself battling through cities infected by the mysterious zombie virus “Snowdrop”, while at the same time becoming tangled in a shocking international conspiracy.

  • Game features:


    Lightning Fast Combat and Shooting.
    Use your array of ranged and close combat attacks to recreate the bloody ballet of movies like “Kill Bill”, reducing the mindless zombie army to glistening red chunks.

    Richly Detailed World
    Whether you’re slicing flesh on the Manhattan Bridge, or blowing holes in fools while rescuing the Queen in Buckingham Palace, Big Day lets you do it in beautiful pixel-art style!

    Explore, Collect, Survive
    Acquire a wide range of weapons and items, enhancing and modifying them to give yourself the edge you need to get through the Big Day!

data.short_description: The Big Day has arrived. Blast your way through the apocalypse in this bloody pixel-art ARPG, riding through the ruins of the last days on Earth following a devastating zombie outbreak. Uncover the truth behind the crisis, find your missing daughter, and blow holes in every zombie who crosses your path!

content_descriptors.notes: Violent pixelart gunplay. Depictions of blood and gore. Sensitive players should take note.

reviews.review:
[h1] EDIT: [/h1][h1] EDIT: [/h1] So its 2019 now, still no answer so this game is officially being labeled as Abandoned by myself and others.. DO NOT BUY IT, GAME AINT WORTH SHIT IF YOU CAN'T PLAY IT.. We as a community have given them since release to redeem it and nothing.. NOTHING... Its a shame.. But theyre already making a new game to do this again because Valve allows it.

[h1] EDIT: [/h1] Im now getting that same bug where you finish a level and the game says its cant connect to camp and crashes, and after that now when you load the game up it immidiately locks up, says it can't connect to camp then crashes. I tried over and over again with the same result.. If you weren't aware Devs, I'm hoping you see this.

[h1] Well worth the cash, still a little rough, still very early in EA.. but you already know if you like these kind of games (twin stick shooter/zombies) Then you'll love this game.. [/h1] There's a few people complaining that the game wont run or crashes, I have had zero of those issues and the devs even tried helping those people but they refuse to actually do things on their end to stop whatever interferring, so they're casual fans to begin with... 

Don't be fooled by those negative reviews.. If you're worried don't buy it and wait but the price usually goes up. Otherwise buy it and try it out, it can only be whittled down to a more smooth experience with time.. This is quite a gem that I only found because of browsing a 3rd party site and NOT steam, they don;t seem to want to promote it. Anyway as far as its EA I'd give this a 7/7.5 out of 10 and improvements the devs make can only blast my score closer to a 9 should everything come together nicely. I mean as far as EA games go you're already ahead of 7 days to Die lol
